brief: @buildthis.bisks.net make a website that uses all the posts from two input handles excluding links and tags to create markov chains from both of their profiles and then lets you generate a brand new post from the combination also allow you to start or end the post with an input sentence
note: built duochain.bisks.net — give it two handles, it strips links/hashtags from both feeds, trains a chain on each, and blends them word-by-word into a new post; you can pin it to start or end on a sentence you type.
